title: CINQ WP MCP site configuration
description: mcp.json at the root of a theme, read by the CINQ WP MCP plugin. Everything is optional except version: the plugin discovers the block zones from ACF on its own, this file only enriches what it finds.

title.description: Name of the MCP server shown to clients. Defaults to the site name.

instructions.description: Editorial rules for the AI client: tone, naming, what never to publish without review. Appended to the server description.

toolPrefix.description: Prefix of every tool name, e.g. "acme" gives acme-list-content. Tells sites apart when one client is connected to several.

postTypes.description: Content types the tools can reach. Defaults to every public type.

zones.description: Block zones: every ACF flexible content field, by dotted path ("blocks", "archive_posts.blocks").

labels.description: Labels shown to clients, keyed by zone id.

pageTemplate.description: "auto" assigns the page template the zone's location rules require, if any. "none" never touches it. A template path is assigned to any page without one that receives blocks.

optionsPages.description: ACF options pages the tools can reach, by menu slug. Defaults to all.

locations.description: Menu locations exposed. Empty means all.

seo.description: SEO plugin the "seo" argument writes through.

redirectUris.description: Extra redirect URIs clients may register, besides Claude's and loopback addresses.

blocks.description: Per-block annotations, keyed by ACF layout name, like styles.blocks in theme.json.

description.description: What the block is for, shown to the AI client.

guidance.description: How to use it well: placement, length, what to avoid.

hidden.description: Leave the block out of what clients are offered.

templates.description: Page templates of the design, as ordered block stacks. Can also live one per file in mcp/templates/<name>.json.

zone.description: Zone the blocks go to. Defaults to the post type's primary zone.

source.description: Where the design lives, e.g. a Figma URL.

status.description: exact: the block is the section. approx: nearest block. theme: rendered outside the stack. missing: no block yet. Defaults to exact with a block, missing without.
